verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a community user describing programming in Replit's web editor, which they say has bugs but works well enough (replit-comm-2). This suggests an in-product code editor exists, but no first-party doc shows opening or editing Agent-generated source code. The docs instead stress 'no coding needed' and visual design tweaking (replit-docs-6), which is not source editing. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an in-builder code editor or file tree for generated code, evidence that manual edits coexist with Agent changes, and recent hands-on corroboration in the Agent-builder context.
